name: International Stable Currency
oneLiner: ISC is a purchasing-power token tracking a basket of physical gold, investment-grade bonds, T-bills, global equities, and cash; price appreciates over time.
collateral: Basket of real-world assets (gold, bonds, T-bills, equity, cash)
pegMechanism: RWA-indexed basket tracking purchasing power; price appreciates over time

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Reviewed local metadata suppression: ISC's "Cash reserves" slice describes generic off-chain cash, not the unrelated CASH token tracked elsewhere.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit No retained: the apparent Upstream signal is a text match on a generic cash reserve label, with no coinId, blacklistable reserve flag, variant parent, CEX custody, or direct stablecoin reserve reference.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: Suppresses a resolver text false-positive where the generic reserve phrase "Cash reserves" matches the tracked CASH symbol. ISC metadata does not identify CASH token exposure or another upstream freezable asset.

mintAuthority.summary: ISC is a Solana SPL token whose mint authority is held by the ISC protocol/team; new ISC is created against assets deposited into the ISC Reserve and the team has pre-minted and released supply, with INTL governance over basket composition.

controls.label: ISC Reserve / team SPL mint authority
controls.evidence: ISC is an uncapped SPL token with an active mint authority controlled by the ISC team/Reserve System; the team has pre-minted RWA-collateralized ISC and released it into circulation, confirming centralized supply control.

review.evidence: ISC project materials describe a Solana SPL token with active (uncapped) mint authority held by the protocol/team; ISC is minted against deposits into the ISC Reserve and via team pre-mints, with INTL governance only over basket composition. No permissionless mint route exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: SPL mint-authority address was not read live on a Solana explorer in this pass; classification rests on issuer-described team-controlled minting and documented pre-mints.
unresolvedQuestions: Read the on-chain SPL mint authority and freeze authority for mint J9BcrQfX4p9D1bvLzRNCbMDv8f44a9LFdeqNE4Yk2WMD on a Solana explorer to confirm the controlling keypair/program.
